name: Hello
author: brodgar
description: Example addon — runs in the Lua sandbox (self-checks it at OnLoad) and demonstrates the event bus, timers, saved variables (hafen.store), custom UI (hafen.ui — a draggable window, a HUD overlay, and world-space gob overlays, all drawn via the GOut wrapper), widget-creation interception (hafen.ui.onWidgetCreate — observes every server window the client builds and logs its {id,type,place,caption,parentType} descriptor), widget models (hafen.ui.adopt — adopts the main inventory as a hidden model: Ctrl+B hides/shows its grid while it stays live, with items() reads and onItemAdded/onItemRemoved/onDestroy events; un-hides on reload/disable), map markers (hafen.markers — reads the on-disk map DB with list/nearest, and Ctrl+Shift+M drops/removes a persistent 'Hello marker' at your position; MarkersChanged fires on changes), radar/minimap icons (hafen.radar — reads the gob-icon categories with categories() -> {name,res,show,notify}, and can setVisible/setNotify per filter; read-only in this addon since the setters persist to your real icon settings), kin/buddy roster (hafen.kin — reads the Kin window with list([filter]) -> {id,name,group,color,online} and find(nameOrId); KinChanged fires when a kin is added/removed or flips online/offline, and hello names who just came online; read-only since kin add/remove/rename is the gated Phase-4 tier), movement speed (hafen.speed — reads the crawl/walk/run/sprint selector with get() -> current 0..3, max() -> highest selectable, name([n]) -> display name; read-only since changing speed is the gated Phase-4 tier), global hotkeys (hafen.key.bind — Ctrl+H toggles the window + an unbound 'ping', both shown under a 'Hello' section in Options > Keybindings), slash commands (hafen.slash.register — a WoW-style ':hello' console command with sub-commands 'toggle'/'ping'/'echo'; args come in as a 1-based table; reload-safe via a single engine-lifetime dispatcher, so :reload swaps the handler with no duplicate/leaked command — coverage-gaps C1), input hooks (hafen.hook.input — a MapView mousedown pre-hook that cancels map clicks while 'map-lock' is on), action hooks (hafen.hook.action — a MapView 'click' pre-hook that intercepts a move and re-sends it while 'move-intercept' is on), message hooks (hafen.hook.message — an IMeter 'set' pre-hook that swallows meter updates so the vitals bars freeze while 'vitals-freeze' is on), and the read API (hafen.gob.*, hafen.world.*, hafen.map.*, hafen.player.* incl. vitals, hafen.time.*, hafen.sound.*, hafen.items.*, hafen.char.* incl. food/skills/credos/experiences, hafen.party.*, hafen.buffs.*, hafen.study.*, hafen.actionbar.*, hafen.radar.*, hafen.kin.*, hafen.speed.*) plus the widget-tree events (VitalsChanged, BuffAdded/Removed/Changed, FepChanged, StudyChanged, ActionbarChanged, EquipChanged), the map event MarkersChanged, and the kin event KinChanged.
